hero.title: Opening and locking solutions
hero.lead: Since 1994, SOFICLEF has designed, manufactured and distributed locks, handles, licence plates and safes. ISO 9001:2015 certified, Authorised Economic Operator.

company.title: The company
company.lead: Identity, vision and scope of activity.

strategy.title: Strategic plan 2024–2026
strategy.lead: Our growth objectives and the industrial projects behind them.

careers.title: Open positions
careers.lead: Current recruitment within the Production Department.
careers.apply: Applications: send your file to the Human Resources Department.

matrix.title: What the job requires, what the person has
matrix.body: Every job carries its expected competencies and their levels. The gap against the assessed level is computed, not entered: it updates the moment an assessment is recorded, and critical gaps surface on their own.

structure.title: A structure that stays true after a reorganization
structure.body: Structures, units and functional cells form a living tree. Nothing is deleted: an archived entity keeps its history and is still referenced by the jobs it once carried.

journey.title: A journey followed day by day, not a document
journey.body: Each step carries its deadline, its owner and its state. Lateness is derived from the date and the status at every read — a finished milestone stops being flagged, a blocked one reaches HR.

pending.title: Account awaiting assignment
pending.lead: Your account exists, but Human Resources has not yet recorded your position. You will reach the platform as soon as that assignment is made.

organization.treeLead: The tree for your perimeter. An archived structure keeps its history and stays referenced by the jobs that cited it.
organization.emptyDescription: No structure is visible within your perimeter.
